name: cx-goal-many-rules
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards. Then open the door with the key and pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the hard Precedence(blocker_moved, door_open) is not stated by the task. “Then open the door with the key” orders opening after taking the key, but does not require opening after moving the ball; the task orders moving the ball before taking the key. Remove this extra order clause. Keep the hard Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key), which captures the stated order.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: the hard order and target goal require the ball moved before taking the key, then opening the door before picking up the box. The key-loss ban and holding-key response are correctly soft preferences.

texts: Take the key only after moving the ball away from the door.
Try not to lose the key while the door is closed.
Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open then or open it afterwards.
Open the door before picking up the box.
Pick up the box in the other room.
